role: Explicit, dated, reviewed waivers for findings that are genuinely open rather than defects of the checker. A waiver downgrades a finding to a warning and restates why it is open and what closes it. It never suppresses or hides it.
rule: Every entry names the check, the exact subjects, why the gap exists, and the condition that closes it. A finding with no entry here is an error. Adding an entry is a review decision, not a convenience.

gaps.why_open: Eleven work-item records cite docs/architecture/_meta/public-web-estate.md as a canon owner. The file exists only on the unmerged branch feat/estate-camera-pipeline (commits 4867803b4, 59432a4aa, fea825174) and is absent from origin/master ba7513bac. The citation is retained rather than deleted, because deleting it would silently narrow eleven records' declared canon scope.
gaps.impact: Any public-claim obligation those records inherit from that owner is unverifiable in a merged checkout. The previous coverage projection additionally named this file as the SOLE owner of its public-claim-boundary obligation, so that obligation had a dangling owner.
gaps.closes_when: the public-web-estate canon owner lands on master, or the eleven records are re-pointed at a merged owner
gaps.closure: docs/architecture/_meta/public-web-estate.md created on program/m0-closure as the canonical owner of the explicitly-public surface class, with a subject row in source-of-truth-map.md. All eleven citing records now resolve.

gaps.why_open: m0-unsigned-review-anchor is verified in both the merged tracked record and its private mirror, but declares no canon owners. It is a workflow-control record (an unsigned review hash-chain anchor) rather than a canon-bearing implementation cut, so it has no natural canon owner. The shape bar still reports it, because a verified record with no declared owner cannot be re-reviewed when canon changes.
gaps.impact: This record is invisible to canon-impact review routing.
gaps.closes_when: the record declares the canon owner that governs review-epoch anchoring, or record_role gains a workflow_control value that is exempt by definition
